title.zh: Frank-Egedal 各向异性压强闭合

summary: Compose a clipped radial flux envelope, a fractional-Legendre loss-cone source, magnetic-field-dependent hot-ion moments and gas/electron/hot pressure assembly on a common two-dimensional grid. The returned closure_state exposes the selected degrees and intermediate normalization; this is a prescribed closure, not a self-consistent equilibrium solve.

identity.relation: Prescribed Frank-Egedal loss-cone hot-ion moments and radial profile to total gyrotropic pressure fields
identity.direction: (poloidal-flux grid, magnetic-field magnitude grid, closure parameters) -> parallel/perpendicular pressure, optional density/electron energy fields and closure state
identity.definition: The radial operator forms r(psi)=max(1-clip((psi-psi_axis)/(psi_edge-psi_axis),0,1),0)^alpha. The source operator either takes caller Legendre degrees or requests loss-cone degrees from the bound spectrum operator, then selects or projects source coefficients. The hot-ion operator integrates moments at b=B/B0 and normalizes parallel pressure and perpendicular pressure to the parallel moment at b=1, while density is normalized to its own b=1 moment. The pressure operator combines p_gd=gas_dynamic_pressure*r, the optional electron term n*electron_temperature, and hot_pressure_scale*r times the respective hot pressure shape. The graph appends the observable closure_state to that pressure mapping.
identity.model: Frank-Egedal fractional-Legendre NBI loss-cone source with finite velocity/pitch quadrature, prescribed gas-dynamic and hot-ion pressure scales, and an optional constant electron thermal-energy scale. No kinetic time evolution, electrostatic closure or force-balance iteration is performed.
identity.geometry: A caller-aligned two-dimensional [Z,R] grid of flux labels and strictly positive local magnetic-field magnitudes; radial dependence is a clipped function of the supplied flux label only.
identity.coordinates: psi and B must be finite same-shape [Z,R] arrays. The historical source labels psi in Wb, but this graph uses psi only through its normalized radial interval and output shape. psi, psi_axis and psi_edge must share one caller-selected flux coordinate; a bounded Wb/rad connection to current SciRel free-boundary Picard has been tested, not generally certified.
identity.boundary: The source loss-cone endpoint is xi_tp_mid=sqrt(1-1/mirror_ratio) for a finite mirror_ratio greater than one; pitch/velocity integration is finite and the local pitch interval vanishes when B/B0 reaches the mirror ratio. The radial envelope clips beyond the caller's axis and edge flux labels.
assumptions: psi and B describe the same physical grid and flux convention, which is a caller obligation beyond shape checks.
The prescribed source, quadrature and pressure scales are suitable for the intended plasma; matching source numerics is not a proof of physical validity.
electron_temperature is an energy in J (or Pa*m^3), not an unconverted Kelvin temperature; density times this energy gives electron pressure in Pa.

inputs.name: psi
inputs.description: Caller flux-label grid used for the radial envelope and final pressure shape.
inputs.units: same flux coordinate as params.psi_axis/psi_edge; historical label Wb, or Wb/rad when coupled to current SciRel free-boundary Picard
inputs.constraints: Finite two-dimensional values. psi_axis and psi_edge default to its minimum and maximum; their finite difference must have absolute value at least 1e-30. A constant grid therefore needs explicit distinct axis and edge values.

inputs.name: B
inputs.description: Local magnetic-field magnitude at the same samples as psi.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; B0 is finite and strictly positive. Shape agreement with psi is checked by the terminal assembly.

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Caller-owned closure configuration passed to the four active operators; see constraints for nested names and defaults.
inputs.units: mixed; psi_axis/psi_edge same as psi, field T, pressure Pa, density m^-3, electron energy J, angle deg and dimensionless controls
inputs.constraints: A dict is required. Radial keys: psi_axis=min(psi), psi_edge=max(psi), alpha=1 with alpha>=0; reversed edge orientation is permitted. Field/source keys: B0=median(B), mirror_ratio=turning_b if mirror_ratio absent, otherwise mirror_ratio (default 2), requiring >1; vc_over_v0=0.25 nonnegative; perp_velocity_lower=vc_over_v0 within [0,1]; beta_m=zeff/2 if absent, otherwise beta_m (default zeff=1), finite. Explicit nonempty finite legendre_degrees bypasses spectrum evaluation; otherwise legendre_mode_count=6 and legendre_spectrum_grid_points=256 control it. source_coefficients must be finite and match degrees if supplied; otherwise nbi_pitch_angle_deg=45 controls projection. legendre_terms=15 must be >=2 and legendre_backend is 'truncated' (default) or 'hypergeometric'. velocity_nodes=pitch_nodes=24 by default, each int-converted value >=2. Pressure keys: hot_pressure_scale=p0 if absent, otherwise hot_pressure_scale (default p0=1); gas_dynamic_pressure=0; gas_dynamic_density=background_density if absent; hot_density_scale and electron_temperature are optional. Present pressure, density and electron-energy scales must be finite and nonnegative; the latter is J, not K. Some nested numeric conversions and Legendre evaluations can raise their native exceptions.

outputs.name: p_parallel
outputs.description: Gas-dynamic plus optional electron plus hot-ion parallel pressure.
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative on successful return; hot term uses hot_parallel_shape normalized at b=1.

outputs.name: p_perp
outputs.description: Gas-dynamic plus optional electron plus hot-ion perpendicular pressure.
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative on successful return; its hot term is normalized to the b=1 parallel moment, so it need not equal p_parallel at b=1.

outputs.name: density
outputs.description: Gas-dynamic radial density plus radial hot-ion density when either density scale is supplied.
outputs.constraints: None when both gas_dynamic_density/background_density and hot_density_scale are absent. The electron pressure is zero when electron_temperature is absent or no density scale is supplied.

outputs.name: electron_temperature
outputs.description: Constant electron thermal-energy field used for the optional electron pressure.
outputs.constraints: None when unconfigured; may be an array even when density is None, in which case the electron pressure remains zero.

outputs.name: closure_state
outputs.description: Inspectable intermediate source and hot-moment state added by the graph, not a convergence certificate.
outputs.units: mixed; normalized fields and mode arrays are dimensionless
outputs.shape: mapping with [N_Z,N_R] normalized_field and radial_shape, [mode] degrees and source_coefficients, scalar xi_tp_mid, degree_source, legendre_backend, legendre_terms, normalization and quadrature
outputs.dtype: Python dict containing NumPy arrays, strings, numbers and a quadrature dict
outputs.constraints: degree_source is 'caller_supplied' or the runtime dependency name 'scirel.kinetic.loss_cone_spectrum' on successful return. quadrature reports velocity_nodes and pitch_nodes. normalization is descriptive; no extra physical residual or convergence result is computed.

preconditions: Finite, nonempty, same-shape [Z,R] psi and positive B grids with a shared caller-verified flux convention.
A finite mirror ratio greater than one, valid source degree/coefficient selection, quadrature controls and nonnegative pressure/density/energy scales.
A nondegenerate radial flux interval, either supplied in params or inferred from a nonconstant psi grid.
supported: Prescribed Frank-Egedal anisotropic pressure and optional density fields on a caller-supplied grid, with explicit or bound-loss-cone Legendre degrees.
Separate gas-dynamic, hot-ion and optional constant-electron-pressure contributions with inspectable mode and normalization state.
excluded: Self-consistent field or equilibrium iteration, quasineutral potential solving, transport evolution or calibration of source and pressure scales.
Automatic Wb-to-Wb/rad flux conversion, coordinate interpolation, magnetic-field reconstruction or proof that the chosen model is physically appropriate.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Nonmapping inputs, missing or nondict params, invalid/nonfinite two-dimensional psi or B, nonpositive B/B0, mirror_ratio<=1, degenerate radial interval, invalid mode arrays/backend/quadrature or negative/nonfinite pressure scales raise ValueError or propagated conversion errors. Missing psi/B are passed as None and fail in downstream validation; unknown params keys are not systematically rejected.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: The bound spectrum, source projection, fractional-Legendre linear solve, NumPy/SciPy quadrature or pressure assembly may raise and abort the graph. There is no substitute degree source or alternate closure after a dependency failure.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: There is no graph-level iteration or convergence flag. The optional loss-cone spectrum uses a finite root scan and raises ValueError if too few accepted modes are found; the graph returns no state in that case.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial mapping is returned after any dependency failure; local intermediate arrays are discarded. On success the five documented keys are returned together, including nullable density and electron_temperature values.

example.description: Evaluate a two-by-two prescribed closure with explicit fractional degree and inspect the returned state without invoking the spectrum solver.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import solve_frank_egedal_pressure_closure
psi = np.array([[0.0, 0.5], [0.25, 1.0]])
B = np.array([[1.0, 1.1], [1.2, 1.3]])
r = solve_frank_egedal_pressure_closure({'psi': psi, 'B': B, 'params': {'psi_axis': 0.0, 'psi_edge': 1.0, 'B0': 1.0, 'p0': 8.0, 'mirror_ratio': 2.0, 'legendre_degrees': [0.5], 'source_coefficients': [1.0], 'velocity_nodes': 6, 'pitch_nodes': 6}})
assert set(r) == {'p_parallel', 'p_perp', 'density', 'electron_temperature', 'closure_state'}
assert r['p_parallel'].shape == r['p_perp'].shape == (2, 2)
assert np.all(np.isfinite(r['p_parallel'])) and np.all(np.isfinite(r['p_perp']))
assert r['density'] is None and r['electron_temperature'] is None
assert r['closure_state']['degree_source'] == 'caller_supplied'
assert r['closure_state']['normalization'] == 'pressure moments referenced to hot_parallel(b=1); density referenced to hot_density(b=1)'
example.expected: Finite two-by-two parallel/perpendicular pressure fields, absent optional density/electron-energy fields and a caller-supplied-degree closure state.

scope: Direct graph tests check finite same-shape pressure fields, explicit source-state reporting, b=1 parallel normalization and nullable density/electron-energy outputs.
A graph test checks that omitted explicit degrees use the bound loss-cone spectrum operator; source and hot-moment tests independently inspect projection and quadrature behavior.

A selected 2*pi flux-coordinate relabeling preserves pressure when axis/edge references move with psi; leaving an edge reference unchanged is a counterexample. A caller-port composition tests one per-radian free-boundary update with nonzero current and circular-filament Green fields.
Direct graph tests reject missing params, incompatible B/psi shapes and a degenerate radial flux interval; a perpendicular-moment limit tests vc_over_v0=1.
verification.evidence_ceiling: The direct SciRel graph and leaf tests establish selected shape, branch, normalization, numeric-limit and invalid-input behavior on small grids. A finite relabeling test and one-step circular-filament composition demonstrate bounded Wb/rad numeric wiring, not full source-feature coverage, arbitrary parameter/flux ranges, physical equilibrium correctness, expert approval or release.
known_limitations: The historical graph labels psi as Wb; current SciRel free-boundary psi is Wb/rad. The tested connection requires psi_axis and psi_edge in the same passed coordinate and does not implement automatic conversion, identify physical flux surfaces or prove general compatibility.
The loss-cone spectrum uses a finite degree scan; the source projection and moments use fixed-order numerical approximations without a general error bound.

The saved historical YAML described turning_b as overriding mirror_ratio, whereas the maintained source evaluates mirror_ratio first when both keys are present; the current document follows the executed code.
Source license and current-version expert recognition remain pending.

nodes.description: Evaluate the clipped flux-envelope array; runtime asset_loader uses the underscored identity.
Bind the public spectrum callable for source projection; its numerical invocation occurs only when legendre_degrees is absent.
Select or generate Legendre degrees and source coefficients, retaining source and backend metadata.
Evaluate field-dependent hot moments and normalize them at b=1 using local quadrature.
Apply caller scales and radial profile to hot moments and optional gas/electron contributions.
Add closure_state with the returned source/moment fields and the fixed normalization description; no scientific relation is recalculated.

edges.description: Common output grid and pressure shape.
Radial axis, edge and exponent controls.
edges.transform: Shallow-copy caller mapping once and pass unchanged.

edges.description: Bound public callable for generated fractional degrees.
edges.condition: The binding is always supplied; the source calls it only when legendre_degrees is absent.
edges.transform: Callable binding without evaluating a spectrum for explicit degrees.

edges.description: Mode evaluator selected by the source backend.
edges.transform: Pass bound callable; no new numerical rule.

edges.description: Hot parallel moment profile normalized at b=1.
Hot perpendicular moment profile referenced to parallel b=1.
Hot density moment profile normalized to density at b=1.

edges.condition: On success; the graph defaults a missing source key to 'truncated'.
edges.transform: Read mapping value or default to 'truncated'.

edges.description: Actual velocity and pitch quadrature node counts.

execution.ordering: Copy params; evaluate radial envelope; bind the spectrum callable and project source modes (invoking spectrum only if degrees are not supplied); integrate hot-ion moments at B; assemble pressure/density/electron-energy fields; append closure_state. The dependency edges are acyclic.
branches: Explicit legendre_degrees bypasses numerical spectrum invocation; absent degrees requests modes through the bound loss-cone-spectrum operator.
Caller source_coefficients bypasses NBI-angle projection; otherwise project coefficients with the selected Legendre backend.
Absent density scales return density=None; electron_temperature may still be returned without adding electron pressure.
execution.state_ownership: The caller owns input arrays and params; the graph makes a shallow params copy and owns only intermediate mappings and returned arrays. The hot-moment operator has a per-call b-value cache; no state persists across calls.
execution.failure_propagation: Any leaf validation or numerical exception stops the call and propagates; no partial pressure mapping or fallback model is returned.
